name: Example: design skill

name: Example: code map
purpose: Turns a folder of code and docs into a queryable map so the agent stops reading files one by one.
use_when: Entering an unfamiliar repo or hunting a function in a large codebase.
dont_use_when: Small repos; building the map costs more than reading.
